## R Programming Peer Mentor

**First-Year Research Immersion Program, Binghamton University**  
<span class="mentor-line">Faculty Mentor: Dr. Shane McCarty</span>  
**January 2025–May 2025**

- Guided students in applying foundational R programming skills toward team-based research projects.
- Collaborated with the instructor and other research assistants to support research teams' Quarto research reports.
- Helped students troubleshoot code, interpret results, and communicate findings in reproducible reports.

## Peer Mentor Educational Resource

**FRI Peer Mentor Mindsets Guide**  
<span class="mentor-line">Co-authors: Dr. Shane McCarty, Dr. Caitlin Light, Zihan Hei, and Dr. Megan Fegley</span>

Co-authored an open-access Quarto guide designed to support reflection, mentoring style, leadership, communication, inclusive mentoring, conflict style, and self-awareness.
